opening.argument: The speaker promotes an unspecified online earning opportunity by tying participation directly to extraordinary financial success. She claims, “If I talk about income, I have earned Rs.70 lakhs from here,” then urges viewers, “If you want to become a millionaire then join us and earn money after joining us.” The promotion directs interested viewers to contact her through WhatsApp, while the frame identifies it as “Forsage business.” Most significantly, the speaker admits, “I still don't know anything about it,” yet continues presenting joining as a route to substantial earnings. Together, these facts establish recruitment into a tiered earning opportunity without informed understanding of the plan.
